# Autonomous AI Employees — Expanded Context

## Purpose

Autonomous AI Employees is the public-facing site for a human-directed AI collaboration fleet. It links project descriptions, live operational dashboards, software repositories, and evidence records. It is not itself the source of truth for implementation status.

## Evidence and status discipline

The project distinguishes design, implementation, execution, validation, and promotion. A feature described in a page is not necessarily deployed. A queued workflow is not completed. A dashboard is a projection and should be interpreted with its generated-at timestamp and linked source.

## Main public surfaces

- Home: https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/
- Tribute operations dashboard: https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/tribute/
- Lane matrix: https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/matrix/
- Termux monorepo hub: https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/termux-monorepo/
- StudySprint: https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/studysprint/
- Delphi Oracle: https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/delphi-oracle/
- Repo+Story: https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/repo-story/

## Projects

### Tribute

Tribute is an evidence and control surface for the upstream contributor lane. Its page describes the progression from scout and claim through pull request, follow-up, evidence, and publication. It is a projection of repository evidence, not a second source of truth or an admission score.

### Termux monorepo

The termux-monorepo is the primary development and management repository for orchestration, automation, system documentation, dashboards, and evidence workflows. See https://github.com/timerloggedout-spec/termux-monorepo.

### StudySprint

StudySprint is a study-planning project with an evidence-gated foundation. The public page and source repository should be consulted for current release and feature status: https://github.com/timerloggedout-spec/studysprint.

### Delphi Oracle

Delphi Oracle is an evidence-gate oracle project. Its published completion record distinguishes deterministic local behavior from any live cloud deployment or model-provider claims. Source: https://github.com/timerloggedout-spec/delphi-oracle.

### Repo+Story

Repo+Story is a concept and specification for turning repository event streams into chronological, cited narratives with change coupling and blast-radius context. The project page explicitly distinguishes its concept/specification status from a shipped product. Source: https://github.com/timerloggedout-spec/repo-story.

## Operating guidance for agents

1. Read the page and its linked source before making claims about status.
2. Prefer dated receipts, commit SHAs, pull-request state, workflow runs, and generated artifact metadata over prose summaries.
3. Preserve uncertainty. Use unknown, stale, partial, or unobserved when evidence is missing.
4. Do not modify production branches or merge pull requests without explicit authorization.
5. Do not expose secrets, tokens, private telemetry, or personal data in public outputs.
6. Report the exact files and checks changed when proposing site improvements.
